sources.citation: Evans, Nicholas. 2021. The phonetics of Papuan languages in Southern New Guinea: an overview. In Lindsey & Schokkin (eds), Phonetic fieldwork in Southern New Guinea (LD&C SP24), ch.1.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Regional remark only (p.7): 'no tone, no pitch accent or distinctive stress except for Urama' for the SP24 sample languages; Mblafe mentioned only for retroflex consonants (p.8). No Ránmo-specific stress statement.

sources.citation: Döhler, Christian. 2018. A grammar of Komnzo. (Studies in Diversity Linguistics 22.) Berlin: Language Science Press.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Ránmo/Blafe appear only in Tonda sound-correspondence tables (§1.4); nothing on Ránmo prosody.

sources.citation: Lee, Jenny Soyeon. 2016. Split Intransitivity in Ranmo. PhD dissertation, Harvard University. xi+226 pp. (Harvard DASH hdl 1/33493578)
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request); access check: online with a university library login
sources.note: Nothing. Syntax dissertation with no phonology chapter; p.10 defers phonology to 'Lee (in prep) Ranmo: a grammatical sketch' (unpublished). a full-text search for stress/accent/syllable/prosody/pitch/tone found no prosodic statement.
